preconditions.description: The number of necklace parts is between 1 and 5 * 10^5, inclusive.
The colors of pearls in each necklace part are non-negative integers less than 2^20.

postconditions.description: The maximum possible beauty of a necklace is between 1 and 20, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: The output permutation of indices p_i forms a cycle.
postconditions.description: Each pearl in the necklace is combined with exactly one other pearl in the cycle, and the cycle starts and ends with the same pearl.

postconditions.expression: The output permutation of indices p_i is a valid necklace permutation.
postconditions.description: The indices of pearls belonging to the same necklace part appear at neighboring positions in the permutation.
